name: Delta MS300 (VFD-MS300) Modbus RTU
model: MS300 series compact drive (Standard Compact Drive MS300)
doc_revision: Delta Standard Compact Drive MS300 Series User Manual, file 4594799_1_DELTA_IA-MDS_VFD-MS300_UM_EN_20170306 (2017-03-06 per file name); Chapter 12, Group 09 communication parameters and Modbus 'Address list'. Third-party (studylib) copy of Delta's manual.
notes: Built from the manual text above; NOT verified on a physical drive. The text was read through a summarising web fetch, so scaling strings such as 'XXX.XX Hz' are as reported there; check them against Delta's current manual. Addressing: the manual quotes hexadecimal data addresses used directly in the Modbus frame (e.g. 2102H in a 03H request to drive 01H), so address_base is 0 and each 'address' is the hex value converted to decimal (2000H=8192, 2100H=8448, 0900H=2304). Parameter Pr.GG-nn is at address GGnnH (manual example: Pr.04-01 = 0401H), so Pr.09-00=0900H=2304 ... Pr.09-04=0904H=2308. Communication defaults per manual: Pr.09-00 address 1, Pr.09-01 9.6 Kbps, Pr.09-04 factory value 1 = ASCII 7N2. This preset's 'connection' assumes RTU 8N1 at 9600, which requires setting Pr.09-04 = 12 (RTU 8N1) first. Function codes per manual: 03H read, 06H write single, 10H write multiple (up to 20 values). SAFETY: the points in group 'control' (2000H drive command: run/stop/direction, 2001H frequency command, 2002H EF/reset/B.B) command a real motor. They are marked rw because the manual lists them as command registers; the manual marks 2000H as write-only, so reading it may return an exception. No min/max for 2001H is given in the part of the manual read (limits depend on drive parameters), so none is enforced here. 2000H bits: b1-0 00 none/01 stop/10 run/11 JOG+RUN; b5-4 00 none/01 FWD/10 REV/11 change direction; b7-6 accel/decel set 1-4; b11-8 0000 master speed, 0001-1111 multi-step 1-15; b12 enable Pr.06-11; b14-13 operation-command source select. 2002H bits: b0 EF on, b1 reset, b2 B.B on. 2101H bits: b1-0 00 stopped/01 decelerating/10 standby/11 operating; b2 JOG; b4-3 direction (00 FWD, 01 REV->FWD, 10 REV, 11 FWD->REV); b8 master freq from comms; b9 from analog; b10 run command from comms; b11 parameters locked; b12 copy-from-keypad enabled. 2100H: high byte = warning code, low byte = error code (code tables are in Chapters 13/14 of the manual, not captured here). Not captured (left out): rows 2108H-2234H other than those listed, error-code tables, and the raw register encoding of Pr.09-01 and Pr.09-03 (shown as raw values). Output current above 655.35 A changes its decimal position per the high byte of 211FH (manual); that is not handled by this preset.

points.name: Drive Command (2000H)
points.note: Bit-coded command word, manual says write-only. COMMANDS REAL MACHINERY (run/stop/direction).

points.name: Control Bits (2002H)
points.note: b0 EF on, b1 reset, b2 B.B on. Commands real machinery.

points.name: Warning/Error Code (2100H)
points.note: High byte warning code, low byte error code.

points.name: Output Current
points.note: XX.XX A; decimal position changes above 655.35 A (see notes).

points.name: Output Torque
points.note: XXX.X %. Signedness not stated in the part of the manual read; treated as unsigned.

points.name: Pr.09-01 COM1 Transmission Speed (raw)
points.note: Manual: 4.8/9.6/19.2/38.4/57.6/115.2 Kbps, factory 9.6, other values fall back to 9.6. Raw register encoding is not stated in the text read, so the raw value is shown unscaled.

points.name: Pr.09-03 Time-out Detection (raw)
points.note: Range 0.0-100.0 s, factory 0.0 (disabled). Raw register encoding not stated in text read; shown unscaled.

points.name: Pr.09-04 COM1 Communication Protocol
points.note: Factory setting 1 (ASCII 7N2). Changes take effect per the manual; changing it can cut the link.
